paragraphs.text: He exhorts them to repentance, and wills them to descend into themselves and gather themselves, lest they be scattered like chaff.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, who have lived uprightly and godly according as he prescribes by his word.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He comforts the faithful in that God would change his punishments from them to the Philistines their enemies, and other nations.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That is, Galilee: by these nations he means the people that dwelt near to the Jews, and instead of friendship were their enemies: therefore he calls them Canaanites, whom the Lord appointed to be slain.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He shows why God would destroy their enemies, because their country would be a resting place for his Church.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: remnant of the house of Judah

paragraphs.text: These nations presumed to take from the Jews that country which the Lord had given them.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: When he will deliver his people and destroy their enemies and idols, his glory will shine throughout all the world.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: for he will famish all the

paragraphs.label: h
paragraphs.anchor: cormorant and the bittern shall lodge

paragraphs.text: Meaning, Nineveh, which rejoicing so much of her strength and prosperity, should be thus made waste, and God's people delivered.
paragraphs.label: i
